comment: The one platform baselines are captured on: the CI screenshots job (macos-26-arm64). An app linked against another Xcode SDK can render differently even on the same simulator, so a run elsewhere can check the harness but not compare against baselines (docs/testing.md#visual-regression-tests).

masks.name: Dynamic Island
masks.why: System UI, not the app: iOS sometimes draws the island into a simulator screenshot around a launch and sometimes doesn't. Pixels, iPhone 17 Pro (1206x2622).
